instruction: Build a small table as five separate closed box solids in millimeters. Name the top top and put it on Table::Top: bounds (0,0,100) to (200,100,110). Name four legs leg_1 through leg_4 on Table::Legs, each 10 by 10 by 100 mm, with minimum corners (0,0,0), (190,0,0), (0,90,0), (190,90,0), respectively. Create the Table parent and both child layers. Leave exactly five objects; preserve pre-existing empty layers, and add only the three specified layers. Match bounds within 0.001 mm and volume within 1%; objects must be visible and unlocked.
